format_contract.checksum_corruption_disposition: LZ4 frame containers are rejected from their magic before flags or checksums are interpreted; ASUPERTRACE v3 SHA-256 coverage remains an A4 integration concern.

vector_provenance.method: Hand-authored from token, length-extension, little-endian offset, overlap-copy, and canonical end-condition rules without using lz4_flex to generate expected bytes.
vector_provenance.oracle_role: lz4_flex 0.14.0 is used only after vector construction for differential validation and remains the production oracle through A5.

valid_vectors.boundary: empty independent block with a final zero token
literal nibble saturation with a zero extension byte
offset-one overlap copy, saturated match nibble, and five final literals
four literals, offset-four match, and canonical five-literal tail

malformed_vectors.boundary: literal nibble requires a missing extension byte
offset exceeds bytes produced by this independent block
saturated match nibble requires a missing extension byte
literal run exceeds the advertised decoded length
decoded bytes are shorter than the size prefix
final literal-only token has non-zero match bits
independent block begins with a match
last sequence has only four literals
last match begins fewer than twelve decoded bytes before block end

properties: owned encode then owned decode preserves bytes
owned output decodes identically with lz4_flex 0.14.0
lz4_flex 0.14.0 output decodes identically with the owned decoder
single-bit mutation and every truncation boundary never panic or exceed declared output limits

bounded_operations: arbitrary candidate decode under compressed, decoded, and ratio caps
owned deterministic encode and roundtrip for payloads at most 256 KiB
current incumbent decode of every owned-accepted block
owned decode of every current incumbent-produced block
zero and u32::MAX size-prefix mutation under the same caps

execution_receipt.runner: RCH-admitted cargo run with the libfuzzer-sys linked main
execution_receipt.instrumentation: libFuzzer execution without cargo-fuzz sanitizer or coverage instrumentation
execution_receipt.command: RCH_REQUIRE_REMOTE=1 rch exec --base HEAD --clean-overlay --no-overlay -- env CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTFLAGS='-D warnings -C debuginfo=0 --cfg fuzzing' CARGO_TARGET_DIR="${RCH_TARGET_BASE:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}}/rch_target_lz4_a3_fuzz_run" cargo run --manifest-path fuzz/Cargo.toml --bin fuzz_trace_compression --release -- -max_total_time=60 -rss_limit_mb=2048 -max_len=1048576

baseline_evidence_disposition.policy: The CAP baseline remains a historical incumbent snapshot. A3 supersedes its LZ4 byte-codec evidence for this campaign without rewriting cross-program baseline history.

required_next_evidence: retained v2 and v3 compressed ASUPERTRACE artifacts
TraceReader, replay, migration, and CLI journeys
combined compressed plus decompressed peak-memory measurement

no_claim_boundaries: This corpus does not integrate the owned codec into trace production or change persisted trace bytes.
It does not prove historical full-trace compatibility; A4 owns retained v2 and v3 ASUPERTRACE artifacts and replay journeys.
It does not add or validate LZ4 frames, dictionaries, block checksums, or content checksums.
A 60-second fuzz smoke is bounded evidence, not exhaustive proof of all possible inputs.
The RCH-admitted cargo run exercises the libFuzzer target without cargo-fuzz sanitizer or coverage instrumentation and makes no sanitizer or coverage claim.
Differential agreement with lz4_flex 0.14.0 does not independently authorize oracle retirement.
It does not prove performance, throughput, allocation, RSS, or latency parity.
It does not authorize production cutover, changing the root Cargo manifest or lockfile, or removing lz4_flex.
It does not cover ATP, Kafka, HTTP compression, or any non-trace LZ4 capability.
It does not prove broad workspace health, release readiness, live RCH fleet availability, local Cargo fallback approval, or permission to delete files.
